text:
deploy-bot: FYI starting staged unpin for runtime v4.0 -> v4.1 in us-west-2 at 09:30 PT. Models: llama3x-quant, llama3x-int8. SDKs observed: sdk-2.6.*, sdk-2.8.*. Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m holds. Rollback/pinback automated. https://go/redwood/ops/unpin-guide :white_check_mark:

sam: Heads-up: v4.1 changes the attention kernel ordering for int8 path which affected a subset of handlers in our beam search. We saw a spike in tail latencies on internal regressions (~+14% p95) at seq=1024 on one canary host.

nina: Did that regression show up for llama3x-int8 or llama3x-quant? We need clear model-group mapping before we advance.

sam: Only llama3x-int8 in the first canary pool. Quant variant fine.

lee: SDK compatibility note: sdk-2.6 clients will drop connections when the new `x-rw-routing` header arrives (we enabled it in v4.1). Customers on 2.6 will see 400s. We should prevent traffic from routes still pinned to 2.6 hitting v4.1.

infra-ci: Quick ops play snippet:
1) Start canary 5% in us-west-2 and us-east-1
2) Attach telemetry probes: latency.p95, errors, host.mem, kv-cache.hit
3) If p95 delta > 10% OR errors > 0.5%, immediate rollback to v4.0 for that model-group
4) Pinback cmd: `infractl pin runtime v4.0 --model-group llama3x-int8 --region us-west-2`

pat: Can deploy-bot enforce traffic routing by SDK header? If so we can exclude sdk-2.6 from canary automatically.

deploy-bot: Yes. We have a routing rule: `route.exclude_if sdk_version ~ "^2\.6"`. I can apply it to canary groups. Confirm and I will bake rule before moving to 25%.

nina: Please apply exclude. Also open an alert for host OOMs — the int8 variant shows +180MB cold-start RAM in v4.1.

sam: Also note: we saw a fallback behavior where kv-cache layout mismatch caused higher backend calls for first-token generation. That impacted throughput until cache warmed (~6K requests). Might skew short-lived function calls.

lee: Suggest adding a traffic shadowing test for sdk-2.6 routes so we can capture errors without impacting customers. Any objections?

pat: No objections. Shadowing will help debug protocol failure logs. I'll schedule an infra job: `./jobs/shadow --routes @sdk2.6 --duration 30m`

deploy-bot: Canary 5% started at 6350098770. Telemetry hooks live. Exclude rule applied for sdk-2.6. Shadow job queued.

infra-ci: Canary metrics @ 6350098785: us-west-2 llama3x-int8 p95 +11.8% (hot), errors 0.08%, mem +180MB. us-east similar. Shadow logs show ~12 4xxs from sdk-2.6 clients (expected).

nina: p95 > 10% threshold — propose halt and investigate before advancing. We should not risk customer-facing regression.

sam: Agreed. Possible mitigations: 1) revert canary hosts to v4.0 for int8 model-group, 2) apply micro-optimizer patch to kernel ordering (low-risk) and re-run canary. Option 2 needs a quick build and smoke test (~45m).

lee: If we revert just int8 model-group hosts back to v4.0, can we continue rolling v4.1 for quant-only models? That would reduce blast radius.

pat: Yes we can stage per-model-group. Recommend: revert int8, continue for quant group to 25% with same checks. Communicate with SDK + CSMs about the int8 rollback.

deploy-bot: Actioning: 1) Pinback int8 model-group to v4.0 in us-west-2 at 6350098792. 2) Continue v4.1 rollout for llama3x-quant to 25% at 6350098795.

infra-ci: Executed pinback. Canary continued for quant group. Hold timers reattached.

nina: I'll collect perf traces from the int8 failed canary and file an incident ticket `INC-2026-int8-kernel-order` with logs + flamegraphs. Sam, please add repro steps.

sam: Will add repro and a short PR checklist for the micro-optimizer.

pat: I'll run the shadow job logs to collate SDK 2.6 failures and send to SDK team. If they can push a 2.6.1 patch to accept the new header, we can re-run full unpin next week.

lee: TL;DR: rolled back int8, continued quant. No customer impact observed. Next steps: SDK team patch, micro-optimizer PR, re-run canary for int8 with patch.

deploy-bot: Final: To abort automated rollout reply `abort` or run `deploy-bot pause 6350098765`. Thread closed when rollout finishes.

pat: Noted. I will draft release note: mention int8 rollback, p95 delta for int8, mem increase, and SDK compatibility gating.

nina: Thanks — will update runbook with new kernel-ordering note and link to incident ticket. :spiral_note_pad:
